label: rem:inter-shell-operator-remark
title: Reading of the inter-shell operator
html: Closure of a shell is indicated by a palindromic histogram. The inter-shell operator is the torus-knot transfer matrix of T_{2,n_s}; it encodes the crossing of a new nucleon, which starts shell \ell + 1, with the closed shell \ell.
heading: Remark
